semantics.visibility_rule: Each exposed evidence dimension follows exact visibility/disclosure policy.
semantics.subject_rule: Subject identity and applicable consent/visibility state are explicit where required.
semantics.recommendation_rule: Recommendation disclosure may depend on both subject and recommender policy.
semantics.project_rule: Private Project evidence is not made public by derived competence projection.
semantics.aggregate_rule: Aggregates cannot reveal restricted source values beyond policy.
semantics.revocation_rule: Visibility revocation removes future projection exposure while preserving governed internal history.
semantics.authority_rule: Public disclosure grants no source mutation authority.

invariants.rule: Identity, portfolio, merit, recommendation, trust and competence states derive only from explicit provenance-bearing evidence; display text, self-authored claims, ranking position or AI inference never become verified evidence by themselves.

Distinct canonical identities maintain independent evidence histories; merit, Tier, trust and recommendation histories are not mergeable across identities unless a future explicit canonical identity-merger contract exists.
